notes.title: Join and support Strange Island
notes.content: [p]“…[i]Nothing is more frightening than a closed door[/i]”  Welcome to [b]Strange Island[/b].[/p][p] Not every horror shouts. [b]Strange Island[/b] whispers. It watches. And slowly, it pulls you deeper. This is our kind of horror — quiet, personal, and lingering. The full story of [b]Strange Island[/b] has already been shaped. From start to finish, we know the path — and our small but committed team follows it with shared focus and intention. This project is deeply important and personally meaningful to each of us, and it [b][u]will[/u][/b] be released — that’s not a maybe, that’s a matter of time.[/p][p]If you’d like to help us cross the finish line a bit faster, here’s how:[/p][p][/p][p]🔹 Stripe (one-time donation) — [url="https://buy.stripe.com/9B6fZjd2U9tYcT57YCaIM02"]https://buy.stripe.com/9B6fZjd2U9tYcT57YCaIM02[/url][/p][p]🔹 Stripe (monthly donation) — [url="https://buy.stripe.com/eVq28t4wo35AdX9a6KaIM00"]https://buy.stripe.com/eVq28t4wo35AdX9a6KaIM00[/url][/p][p]🔹 Ko-fi — [url="https://ko-fi.com/blackbearstudio"]ko-fi.com/blackbearstudio[/url][/p][p]🔹 Patreon — [url="https://patreon.com/blackbear_studio"]patreon.com/blackbear_studio[/url][/p][p][/p][p]🎁 As a token of appreciation, we will add [b][u]20 unique Easter eggs[/u][/b] to the game — each one honoring a generous supporter who joined us along the way. It’s our way of saying thank you and leaving a trace of[b] your presence in the game. [/b]🧩 [i]We’ll personally contact selected supporters before adding any Easter egg — nothing will appear without your approval.[/i][/p][p]Thank you for taking an interest in our project. There’s still a long road ahead — and we’re doing our best to make it unforgettable. [/p][p]Want to follow the journey more closely? You’re welcome to join us on Discord.[/p][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/Mbmkp9jJcq"]https://discord.com/invite/Mbmkp9jJcq[/url][/p][p] [/p][p][i]The Strange Island Dev Team[/i][/p]
